tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The screen behind everything.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Grouped takeoffs, the current-estimate strip, the total bar, the tab bar and unselected options.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside a text field. Nothing else.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed and hovered rows and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, sheet, field and pressed: 10.47:1 or more in both themes. Also the rules that open and close a total.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Instructions, labels, units, assumptions and disclosures on ground, sheet, field and pressed: 4.56:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text on field: 5.0:1 light, 5.57:1 dark. Never a real value or a label.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Field blue. The current selection, section numbers, the active tab, the focus ring, the primary button and the total, on ground and sheet: 6.16:1 or more.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: 7.00:1 light, 7.35:1 dark. Dark on purpose in the dark theme.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Lines between sections and rows. Decorative, under 3:1, so it never marks a control's edge.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: The edge of inputs and unselected options: 3.33:1 or more on every surface a control sits on.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Validation text and invalid field borders on ground and sheet: 6.03:1 or more. Always with an alert icon and a sentence.

tokens.name: adjusted
tokens.usage: Lumber-crayon ochre. Only a manually overridden quantity: tag, status line and field border. 5.98:1 or more on ground, sheet and adjusted-wash.

tokens.name: adjusted-wash
tokens.usage: The fill behind the Manual tag, under adjusted text.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark, on the Home masthead only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The title of every screen but Home.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Measure the work, review the materials, then enter your own unit prices.
styles.usage: Lead sentences and typed values. 16px also stops mobile browsers zooming on focus.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: The name in a list, setting or material row.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Enter dimensions in metres unless another unit is shown.
styles.usage: Instructions, units, validation and supporting lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Assumptions, disclosures and quantity status. The smallest reading size.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: The tagline, the Manual tag and tab labels. Short words only.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Quantities and subtotals, right-aligned with tabular figures.

styles.name: total
styles.usage: The total in a running sheet, in accent.

styles.name: total-display
styles.usage: The total at the head of Estimate Results, once per screen.

spacing.note: Named by pixel value on a 4px base, with one 2px step for tightly paired text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between two lines of one entry.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: A label to its field; an icon to its word.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between option buttons and between rows inside a material.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Field grid gap, field padding, and below a section heading.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen side and top padding; sheet side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Screen bottom padding.

radius.note: Square corners are the system. A token exists so nothing invents a radius.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every control, surface, tag and fill.

size.note: Fixed dimensions. Controls are sized for gloved, outdoor use.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of inputs, options and buttons.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a list or setting row.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: TabBar height, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: field-min-width
tokens.usage: A field never narrows below this; the grid wraps instead.

tokens.name: sheet-max-width
tokens.usage: The sheet is centered and capped at this on wider screens.
